proposals.evidence: Turner derives Nepali kum shoulder from kumba thick end of a bone. Dotyali kum in the elbow prompt is a qualified neighbouring-language comparison with a shift between shoulder and elbow, both joint ends; the survey gloss remains elbow and the link does not assert that Nepali itself means elbow.
